title: M-t (transpose-words) at end of line panics zshrs at zle_word.rs:1422

observed.detail: zshrs: crashed: panicked at, run with `RUST_BACKTRACE
observed.crash: thread 'main' panicked at src/ported/zle/zle_word.rs:1422:48: index out of bounds: the len is 17 but the index is 17
observed.notes: The completer in the fixture is never reached: the buffer is a plain `ls` command line and ESC-t is transpose-words. The buffer is 17 bytes, which is the index the panic reports. Reproduced outside the harness too, on a bare `target/debug/zshrs --zsh -f -i` with ZDOTDIR unset: type the buffer, send \x1bt, the process dies. No zstyle is involved — the combo_5_0_e0 reproducer this came from carried one, and it is not needed.

zshrs_binary.kind: debug build under target/ (NOT the Homebrew-installed zshrs)

zsh_binary.note: Homebrew zsh 5.9.2, which is what `zsh` on PATH resolves to here; /bin/zsh is an older build and is NOT what any harness runs.

confirmed.note: round 6 re-confirmation, from the full gate run in tests/compsys_fixtures/last_gate.json. What that run established: verdict STILL-DIVERGES; the harness's own detail was 'zshrs: crashed: panicked at, run with `RUST_BACKTRACE'; this harness computes no fingerprint, so what was re-verified is the verdict and that detail line, not row-for-row identity with `observed`

history.note: all three harness files had uncommitted edits when this was confirmed (three agents were editing them concurrently); the sha256 prefixes above pin the exact bytes used.
